name: rt_sigqueueinfo
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_rt_sigqueueinfo, pid_t tgid, int sig, siginfo_t *info);
int syscall(SYS_rt_tgsigqueueinfo, pid_t tgid, pid_t tid, int sig, siginfo_t *info);
Note: There are no glibc wrappers for these system calls; see NOTES.
description: The rt_sigqueueinfo() system call sends a signal and additional data to a thread group. The rt_tgsigqueueinfo() system call sends a signal and data to a specific thread in a thread group. These are low-level interfaces not intended for direct application use.

parameters.name: tgid
parameters.description: The thread group ID (process ID) to send the signal to.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a siginfo_t structure containing additional data.

parameters.name: tid
parameters.description: The thread ID to send the signal to (for rt_tgsigqueueinfo only).

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The limit of signals which may be queued has been reached.
sig, tgid, or tid was invalid.
The caller does not have permission to send the signal to the target.
No thread group matching tgid was found for rt_sigqueueinfo, or no thread matching tgid and tid was found for rt_tgsigqueueinfo.

versions: Linux 2.2 for rt_sigqueueinfo, Linux 2.6.31 for rt_tgsigqueueinfo
